title: Officials evasive on crash materials of unknown origin

tellings.quote: possession. I was told by way of omission when it comes to the subject of do we have materials in our possession. Okay. There's been a wishy-washy response to that.

plain: When officials in the United States are asked whether the government holds materials of unknown origin, the kind said to come from crashed craft, they give a wishy-washy answer and avoid saying no. The author Peter Levenda says this on the show, explaining that he was told "by way of omission": what the officials left unsaid was the answer. If true, it would hint that such materials are held and that officials will not deny it.
